Falcons vs Saints DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, October 5 · NFL Week 4 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 5, 10:34 AM ET

Bijan Robinson has the highest SPAGS projection in the Falcons at Saints DraftKings Showdown: 22.6 points at $11,800 FLEX, 33.9 at captain for $17,700. Across 100,000 simulations Robinson holds 71% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Robinson is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 10.6 points at an $11,800 FLEX salary, in a game with a 47.5-point total.

He also has the largest captain share: 24.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Robinson at captain. Tyler Shough is the next captain in line, at 16.2%. The model has him running 3.9 times.

New Orleans is a 1.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 24.5 for the Saints and 23 for the Falcons.

Behind Robinson and Shough, the next projections are Chris Olave (18.9, $10,800), Drake London (16.8, $10,000) and Michael Penix Jr. (16.0, $9,000).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 5, 10:34 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Bijan Robinson, ATL RB ($11,800 FLEX / $17,700 CPT)

Bijan Robinson holds 24.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $17,700 and the 22.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 33.9 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 18.1 carries and 5.0 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Robinson averaged 22.5 points with a simulated floor of 10.6 and a ceiling of 39.1. He holds 71% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 24.2% as the captain and 46.6% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Tyler Shough, NO QB ($9,600 FLEX / $14,400 CPT)

Tyler Shough holds 16.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,400 and the 19.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 29.4 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 3.9 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Shough averaged 19.7 points with a simulated floor of 7.8 and a ceiling of 35.9. He holds 68% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 16.2% as the captain and 52.0% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Chris Olave, NO WR ($10,800 FLEX / $16,200 CPT)

Chris Olave holds 14.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $16,200 and the 18.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 28.4 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 10.1 targets on 35.4 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Olave averaged 18.9 points with a simulated floor of 7.4 and a ceiling of 38.8. He holds 53% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 14.6% as the captain and 38.9% in a FLEX spot.

Drake London, ATL WR ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Across 100,000 simulations London averaged 16.8 points with a simulated floor of 5.4 and a ceiling of 35.6. He holds 45% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 13.1% as the captain and 31.5% in a FLEX spot.

Michael Penix Jr., ATL QB ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

Across 100,000 simulations Penix averaged 16.1 points with a simulated floor of 6.5 and a ceiling of 29.3. Across 100,000 simulations Lance averaged 4.5 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 14.2. He holds 13% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.6% as the captain and 12.8% in a FLEX spot.

Bijan Robinson leads the SPAGS model at 22.6 DraftKings points for $11,800 at FLEX, or 33.9 points at captain for $17,700.

Bijan Robinson is the most expensive player at $11,800 FLEX and $17,700 at captain. All 27 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.
